convention: y-up, root at feet, meters; bone names lowercase with .l/.r
bone_axis: Y along bone (head->tail), X = principal bend axis, Blender roll 0 on limbs

extended.fingers: hand.{l|r}.{thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky}.{1..3} — knuckle .1 parents .2 parents .3; templates bind one stub per finger to .2 so mitten geometry can still articulate

compat: superset of v1 — v1 clips keyframe shared bone names and keep working; extended bones rest unless a clip keys them
notes: clips must stay within rom bounds; sockets are the only legal attachment points; extended bones may be present-but-unbound when the mesh lacks the geometry (fused-hand blobs bind to hand.*, not fingers)
